name: Credit limit intro (hosted baked page) + exit, natural hold

recordedWith.viewport: 360x800 CSS px, deviceScaleFactor 2, mobile, touch emulation

trigger: page load (t=0 = navigation start of the document)
t0: t=0 = first animation frame where: document.querySelector('.ps-climit iframe')
propertyLegend: x/y/w/h = getBoundingClientRect (CSS px, includes transforms); tx/ty/sx/sy/rot = computed transform matrix decomposed (px, scale, deg); blur = filter blur px; opacity = computed opacity of the element itself; opacityEffective = product of ancestors; other names are computed CSS values.
notes: App opening with Tune intro on: the Credit limit page plays in its frame, posts 'creditlimit:done', holds 3000 ms (no tap), then exits into the home card. t=0 = first frame the intro frame exists. doneAt = performance.now() of the done message (page clock).
